title: Ramsbergbahn Ramsau in the Zillertal
name: Ramsbergbahn Ramsau in the Zillertal
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Ramsbergbahn near Ramsau im Zillertal: leisurely single-seater chairlift up the Ramsberg to 1,300 m with magnificent views of the Zillertal.
beschreibung:
Overview

The nostalgic Ramsbergbahn is situated in the holiday village of Ramsau im Zillertal (Bezirk Schwaz) in the heart of the central Zillertal at a valley elevation of around 600 metres above sea level. As one of the very last classic single-seater chairlifts in the entire Alpine region, this storied lift carries visitors up to the sun-drenched Ramsberg at around 1,300 metres in a serene, nature-centred manner. Far removed from the hustle and bustle of high-capacity gondolas, the Ramsberg offers pure relaxation, an unspoilt cultural landscape, and sweeping vistas over the Zillertal and the imposing precipice of the Gerlossteinwand.

Nostalgic Ride & Hiking Idyll

Riding this historic chairlift is a true celebration of unhurried travel: quietly and gently, passengers float in individual seats above flowering mountain meadows, centuries-old farmsteads, and fragrant spruce woodlands. At the mountain terminal, a sunny high plateau unfolds, serving as an ideal starting point for family-friendly alpine pasture hikes and scenic circuit walks. Popular walking destinations include the easy forest trail leading to the mountain inn Sonnalm and onward to the Gerlosstein plateau. En route, nature-themed info panels and handcrafted wooden sculptures introduce visitors to traditional Zillertal farming heritage and the wildlife of the Tuxer Alpen. In winter, the Ramsberg serves as a snow-sure launchpad for toboggan runs and tranquil winter walks.

Visit & Getting There

The Ramsbergbahn operates during the summer season from late May to mid-October daily between 08:30 and 16:30, weather permitting. Summer chairlift fares (2025/2026 season): round trip adults approx. €16.50, seniors approx. €14.50, children (aged 6 to 15) approx. €9.50; single ascent or descent approx. €11.00. Holders of the regional Zillertal Activcard ride the chairlift free of charge. Arriving by car: via the Inntalautobahn A12, exit Wiesing/Zillertal, continuing on the Zillertalstraße B169 south for about 25 km to Ramsau im Zillertal, then follow signs to the valley station of the Ramsbergbahn (free parking directly at the lift). Public transport: take the Zillertalbahn (train or bus) to the station Ramsau-Hippach, followed by an easy ten-minute stroll to the valley station.

Tips

This gentle single chairlift is ideally suited for leisure walkers and nature lovers looking to appreciate the alpine landscape away from the crowds (backpacks can be easily carried along; bicycles are transported upon prior inquiry). Stop off at the charming mountain inn at the top station and enjoy authentic Zillertaler Krapfen pastries on the panoramic sun terrace overlooking the broad Zillertal valley basin.
